propositions: warn_if_cache_ineffective emits warnings for all prompts with zero cache counters below 4096-token floor, where caching cannot occur by design
the warning predicate has no lower bound and fires on every sub-floor call despite CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS constant already documenting the floor
duplicate constant definition across pass1.py and structured_run.py creates sync risk and obscures shared design invariant
per-call warnings at high volume (~20 per gate run) train operators to filter the signal, reducing alarm credibility when genuine cache defects occur
single cacheable prompt that fails to cache remains undetectable above floor while false alarms below floor dominate the log
aggregate run telemetry shows cache working (cache_write > 0) but per-call warnings claim no effect, contradicting run's own usage data
